title: Shiraishi An — Despite Being Partners〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
G-Good morning.
Is An here?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah.
An, your friend's here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, you're already here?
Is it that late?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, um... Before we start practice in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh! You want to do some warm-ups?
In that case, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a favor to ask, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A favor...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to try singing with you. Um, without you holding back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're always doing what you can to help me keep up, but if we keep doing that, I feel like I'll never actually grow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've been practicing a lot lately. I even started doing solo performances on the street and I think I've improved a little.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to test myself.
By singing with you as best I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three!
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's struggling to keep up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to test myself.
By singing with you as best I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm not gonna go easy on her!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She needs to know I recognize her as a singer that's on the same level as me!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you're so amazing. I couldn't keep up at all. I guess I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you're gonna be just as amazing too, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll definitely catch up to you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know you will...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh, I can't believe I was so narcissistic and thought you needed my protection!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told you earlier that I kept thinking I had to look after you until Akito pointed out to me that it was unfair, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was because it felt good having you rely on me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you keep proving to me, like just now, that you don't need any of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're strong enough to get back up and try again without my help after you stumble or even fall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I believe in you, so I'm going to sing as best I can too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It took me way too long to notice that.
I was so blind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
From now on, I'll just be leading you.
Not some selfish mentor, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's give it our best, partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
We're in this together!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What's up, Dad?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Not to interrupt your lovely chat, but weren't you going somewhere today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Gasp! Wait, no!
We're gonna be late!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We've gotta hurry or the guys will get mad over making them wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let me just grab this and we're good to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
By the way, Kohane!
I've got a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't we sing that song again in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: With everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! I'm up for that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright then!
Let's go, partner!
